title: FlexCore — command lifecycle SLIs
description: P11.09 dashboard-as-code (Phase 11 wave 1, Agent B). The command-lifecycle service's SLIs over the frozen 14-state lifecycle: every panel queries a family named in the P11.01 taxonomy record — no panel invents a metric, and no query invents a state (state names come from the frozen vocabulary only). WRITTEN-UNRUN.

panels.title: Transitions by target state (flexcore_command_state_transitions_total)
panels.description: Only the 27 legal frozen edges render (the label pair is bounded by construction); VALIDATED and FEASIBLE never appear as targets (no event exists and none may be invented).

panels.title: Terminal-state ratio (derived, 1h)
panels.description: Transitions INTO the five frozen terminal states (COMPLETED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, FALLBACK) over transitions to APPROVED — the P11.02 register's SLO 4 definition (APPROVED is the last gate a command cannot bypass), derived in the query per the P11.01 record, never stored as a second metric. FAILED and EXPIRED are NOT terminal (they exit only via FALLBACK).

panels.title: Accept latency — p95 (flexcore_command_accept_duration_milliseconds)
panels.description: The accept-latency SLI histogram from the P11.01 record (registered bucket set; le="500" is the registered good-event threshold candidate, RECOMMENDATION).

panels.title: Stuck commands (flexcore_commands_stuck)
panels.description: Named in the P11.01 taxonomy record; the family is implemented in wave 2 (P11.20) and until then this panel renders no data — written honestly, never faked.
